one_routine_witness.visible_choice: When he could press to display his talent first, he uses the immediate turn to bring the drill balls to the start point and replace them there for the next short repetition. He does not request an immediate verdict or praise before doing the assigned preparation.
one_routine_witness.direct_current_cost: The brief turn and attention available for his own showcase are spent on a task that brings no immediate praise; his wish to prove himself remains, and T2 later exposes the unchanged skill/judgment/position deficit.
